reviews.content: Works well, easy to install and affordable price. Remember to install it prior to traveling because you need internet connection for that.
Excelente producto a buen precio y funciona muy bien 👌
Works perfectly, no issues, smooth delivery!

body.subtitles: Get instant mobile data in Spain.
body.descriptions:
Stay in touch with friends and family using popular apps without any limitations. Get connected to the internet with the best cellular networks using an international eSIM. Travel eSIMs are easy to set up: You will receive a QR code immediately. Scan the code with your phone's camera, and you'll be connected to the internet within minutes. It's just that easy!

  • High-speed connection - Connect to the best network.
  • Get an instant internet connection.
  • Keep your primary SIM while traveling worldwide.
  • No hidden fees.

Important

Please, before purchasing, ensure the availability of coverage and device compatibility, as network coverage is limited to the plan's designated country or region.
body.instructions:
After purchase, you will receive a QR Code and activation code, with instructions to install the eSIM through Settings.

  1. Scan the QR Code or add the activation code manually.
  2. Turn on data roaming from your Settings.
  3. Enjoy the fast network connection!

Reminder: To install the eSIM, a stable internet connection is necessary. Consider setting up the eSIM before traveling abroad, allowing instant access to the connection upon arrival. This eSIM can only be installed once. Validity starts when connected to a compatible network.
body.techSpecs:
• Coverage: Free roaming in the following countries
  • Plan type: Data only
  • Speed: 3G/4G
  • Network: Orange España, Movistar España, Vodafone España, Yoigo
  • Validity time: You can activate the eSIM before heading to any of the supported countries, but its validity time won't begin until you turn it on within one of those countries.
  • APN: data.esim
  • Wifi hotspot: Supported
  • Phone number: Not included
  • SMS: Not supported
  • Unlimited product specifics:
    • Plan type: Unlimited Data
    • Throttling: Throttling applies after the following data limits have been reached:
      • 5 Days: 30 GB
      • 10 Days: 60 GB
      • 15 Days: 90 GB
    • Speed: 2G/3G/4G/5G
    • After the above data limits have been reached, the eSIM is throttled to a speed of 2 Mbps. This is sufficient for regular internet usage but may affect certain live streaming services.
    • Network: Orange (Spain), Telefónica Móviles (Movistar)
